description: Distributor monitors recruited materializers; on death swaps placeholder into the TSL slot (A4 delta) and requests re-recruitment (A5, with backoff). Stale clients race dead pid -> :unavailable -> retry -> placeholder. Integration test: kill materializer, read succeeds after heal.

comments.text: From PR #94 second-pass audit: stale-forward black hole is confirmed q67.7 scope — when a covered materializer dies, placeholder's covered map retains the dead pid; forwards fail {:failure, :unavailable, pid} with no re-park/re-demand. Healing must clear covered[tag] (and TSL slot) on death. Also tolerate the deliver-races-restart drop: deliver_coverage cast to a dead placeholder is silently lost while pending_demands clears — re-demand from the restarted placeholder must re-trigger delivery (dedupe layers verified to desync only in safe directions).

title: Materializer death healing: placeholder swap + re-recruitment
